responsibility: Implements the straight-line strength reduction pass (slsr) on SSA GIMPLE. Walking the CFG in dominator order, it records candidate expressions and address computations of the form base-plus-index-times-stride or related MEM_REF address patterns, links dominating basis candidates, performs cost/profitability analysis for constant and variable strides including PHI-dependent cases, inserts initializer and edge code when needed, and rewrites multiplies and complex addressing into cheaper incrementally-derived forms.
